thesis.infer: Price fell and BTC OI rose with funding flat, so we read new shorts pressing a risk-off tape rather than long liquidation or crowded carry; the macro-driven same-sign move with Nasdaq supports that. Consensus is pricing a hold or a small hike probability for Oct 28 (not re-verified today); we read the risk as hawkish given the 10Y above 5% and Brent above $110. The disagreement: Fear & Greed is still stretched (z30 +1.78) and hl-cycles reads risk-on, while price, tech and stablecoin supply are weakening and the Macro lens is Restrictive, so risk skews toward sentiment catching down to price.
thesis.forecast: Base case (we lean here, low-confidence): BTC chops around the ETF cost basis ($81.7K) into the Oct 28 FOMC; a daily close back above $81.7K keeps the hl-cycles regime intact, and a daily close below it is the stated invalidation. Tail case (low-confidence): a daily close below the True Market Mean ($79.2K) could put the STH cost basis ($74.6K) in play, more likely with a hawkish surprise. Second tail case (low-confidence): a dovish hold with oil under $100 may let stablecoin supply recover and lift tech, with the Mean MVRV price ($105.7K) far overhead.
